<!-- generated by FlowCast Studio from https://wso2.com/integration-platform/docs/connectors/catalog/erp-business/sap.businessone.localization/example -->

## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Example`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-businessone-localization-example`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Example**.

## Step 2: Open the connector palette

1. Select **Add Connection** in the **Connections** section.

## Step 3: Select the Localization connector

1. Search for `ballerinax/sap.businessone.localization`.
2. Select **Localization** connector.

## Step 4: Bind the connection parameters to configurable variables

1. <!-- manual: Bind every required connection field to a configurable variable. - Session : Bind the SAP Business One session settings to configurable variables. - Connection Name : Enter localizationClient as the connection name. -->

## Step 5: Save the connection

1. Select **Save** and verify that the connection appears in the **Connections** section.

## Step 6: Set actual values for your configurables

1. Select **Configurations** at the bottom of the project tree under **Data Mappers**.
2. Run the shell command `.venv/bin/python tools/write_config.py --project sap-businessone-localization-example --expect companyDb,userName,password` to set the configurable values.

## Step 7: Add an automation entry point

1. Select **Add Entry Point** next to **Entry Points**.
2. Select **Automation**.
3. Select **Create** to accept the settings.

## Step 8: Expand the connection and configure the listBEMReplicationPeriods operation

1. Select **Add Step** in the automation flow.
2. Select **localizationClient**.
3. Select **List Bem Replication Periods**.
4. Review the generated result variable for the returned collection.
5. Select **Save**.
